verdict.rationale: Anrok's dashboard shows a world exposure map and jurisdiction-level tax obligations, filings can be fetched via API, and the product emphasizes filing-ready detail and done-for-you filings, supporting jurisdiction-level liability visibility. However, evidence does not explicitly confirm a real-time 'collected vs owed' accrued liability view or detail GL/accountant-consumable export formats. missing for 10: explicit accrued liability (collected vs owed) reporting view, documented GL/accountant export formats (e.g., CSV/QBO/NetSuite journal entries), and independent confirmation of real-time accuracy.
